	major = yes
	government = monarchy
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_principate
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_augustan_dyarchy
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_provincial_principate
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_flavian_imperial_settlement
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_antonine_provincial_principate
			has_reform = government_reform:antq_severan_military_principate
		}
	}
	country_modifier = {
		global_crown_estate_power = 0.10
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.10

		replace_cabinet_member_cost_modifier = 0.10
	}

	years = 2
}
